name: Death Shuffle
description: Every time you die, the level music switches to a random song you downloaded for that level with Jukebox.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Switch to a random Jukebox song every time you die.

shuffle-first-attempt.name: Shuffle the first attempt too
shuffle-first-attempt.description: Start the level with a random song instead of its normal one.

in-practice.name: Work in practice mode
in-practice.description: Also shuffle songs when dying in practice mode.

include-default-songs.name: Include the level's original song
include-default-songs.description: Also put the level's normal song (the one it shipped with) into the shuffle, not just the Jukebox songs you downloaded for it.

use-song-offset.name: Use Jukebox start offsets
use-song-offset.description: Start each song at the offset you set for it in Jukebox.

sync-start-pos.name: Sync to start positions
sync-start-pos.description: When you spawn from a start position or checkpoint, skip ahead in the random song by the same amount the level's song would. Turn off to always start songs from the beginning.

show-song-name.name: Show song name
show-song-name.description: Pop up a small notification with the song's name when it changes.
